description: Gearshift Desktop uses an authenticated local helper to route eligible new local subagents. Either explicit setting and full history are preserved. The helper uses the user's own OpenAI API key. Missing helper, credentials or a fresh matching host catalog leaves the spawn unchanged. PostToolUse records requested settings separately from verified child runtime settings. No latest user prompt is collected.
